messages:
Maya (Product): quick follow-up from the all-hands thread — we need canonical rows for API GA, Console parity (per-route metrics + token breakdown), and Optimize features. please paste single-line rows or update the tracker: https://internal.redwood/roadmap (owner-only). include owner, canary start, GA target, and 1 test/acceptance check.
David C: runtime update: KV-cache fix merged, CI perf rigs green. proposing canary for API v4.2 start Apr 29, GA target May 13 if no regressions. acceptance: sustained p95 latency within 10% of baseline + error-rate <0.1%.
Jordan (Eng): rollout plan: 5% -> 15% -> 40% -> 100% (4-day ramps by default). automated rollback if error-rate spike or latency >2x. canary command: `./deploy-canary --service api-v4.2 --percent 5`.
Sophie L: Console status: per-route metrics backend is shipping; UX prototype for per-route drilldown ready Wed Apr 24. token-breakdown requires an aggregation job; engineering estimate + QA pushes token-breakdown GA to May 20. acceptance: drilldown shows token chart for top 10 routes and per-token cost breakdown.
Eli - ML: Optimize items: batching autosuggest canary May 3, require A/B showing token-cost reduction >=15% and p95 latency <120ms. quant recommendations canary May 17 gated by eval harness (accuracy delta <1% vs baseline on eval set). I'll own the eval harness and post results to the tracker.
Sam Ops: note for Dedicated customers: we need a migration checklist and a dry-run script. i'll drop `dedicated-migrate.md` in the tracker tonight. DB/config changes are backward compatible but we'll provide `migrate-config --dry-run` to be safe.
Zach: SDKs: plan minimal patch release for client tweaks + deprecation notes. changelog + sample migration snippet (Node + Python) by Apr 20. prefer not to bump major to avoid churn.
Maya (Product): nice. please paste rows exactly as: `Feature — Owner — Canary start — GA target — AcceptanceCheck`. i'll consolidate into a single table after EOD.
Jordan (Eng): API GA — Jordan — Apr 29 canary start — May 13 GA target — Acceptance: p95 latency within 10% and error-rate <0.1% during 7-day canary.
Sophie L: Console per-route metrics — Sophie — Apr 24 canary start — May 20 GA target (token-breakdown may lag) — Acceptance: per-route drilldown shows tokens + cost for sample traffic and UX signoff.
Eli - ML: Optimize batching autosuggest — Eli — May 3 canary — May 24 GA (staggered after A/B) — Acceptance: A/B shows >=15% token cost reduction and p95 <120ms.
Eli - ML: Optimize quant recs — Eli — May 17 canary (eval gating) — GA TBD (post-eval) — Acceptance: eval delta <1% vs baseline on safety/accuracy evals.
David C: Runtime perf fix — David C — Apr 18 merged (perf bench green) — coordinating canary with Jordan. Acceptance: internal perf harness shows no regression on concurrency matrix.
Zach: SDK patch — Zach — Apr 20 release — Apr 20 docs + changelog — Acceptance: major client tests pass and no breaking calls in smoke tests.
Sam Ops: Dedicated migration checklist — Sam Ops — doc in tracker Apr 19 — rollout notes ready — Acceptance: run `migrate-config --dry-run` against staging for two sample tenants.
ReleaseBot: ReleaseBot: canary job created for api-v4.2 at 2631130060 — 5% traffic in us-west-2 :rocket:
Maya (Product): perfect. thanks all — i'll pull these into the tracker and ping sales/solutions with a single summary. if anything slips, update the tracker and shout here. :thumbsup:
